resources.string: Experimental · Translate media from a selected app.
Experimental · Two-way translation for an active app call.
Start a call in the selected app first. Incoming speech translates their language into yours; outgoing speech translates yours into theirs. Stopping restores the original call.
Kotoba uses its model voice. Grok and the local combination offer voice choices. The local combination currently supports Chinese and English.
Speech recognition and synthesis run on this device in both directions. Transcribed text is sent to the system text model. Only calls in the selected app are connected.
Call audio in each selected fal direction is sent directly to fal. Local directions upload only transcribed text. Only the selected app is connected.

Audio segments are uploaded to the fal temporary file service for Whisper recognition, then translated by the system text model. Only captions are shown and original audio is kept. Browsers are handled as a whole app.
Speech recognition and synthesis run on this device. Only transcribed text is sent to the system text model. Media audio from the selected app is processed; browsers are handled as a whole app.
Audio is sent directly to fal. Media audio from the selected app is processed; browsers are handled as a whole app. Play a video after connecting to start translation.
Allow overlays, then enable the overlay again.
Allow overlays, then start translation again.
Overlay enabled. Return to the home screen to see it.
For the first translation, choose an app, languages, and output mode, then tap Start. After that, you can start directly from the home page.
Choose different source and target languages.
The local combination currently supports Chinese and English.
